description: This C# source file defines the `DbTestAppFactory` class used for setting up a test host environment with in-memory or Docker-provisioned PostgreSQL database for integration testing. It includes logic for environment configuration, database migration application, and token-based authentication setup for testing purposes.

classes.name: DbTestAppFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating a web application test host with a PostgreSQL database backend, supporting environment setup, database provisioning via environment variables or Docker, and authentication token retrieval for testing.

methods.name: CreateAuthedClient
methods.description: Creates an HttpClient configured with authorization header and correlation ID for testing authenticated endpoints.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Configures the web host for testing, overriding environment and services to connect to the test database.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Performs setup operations such as provisioning the database, applying migrations, and obtaining an access token for authorized requests.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources, such as disposing of the PostgreSQL container if used.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsAsync
methods.description: Runs SQL migration scripts to set up the database schema.
